claim: /shelf says the archive is 'מסודרים לפי סדר השנה', and /shelf/upload asks which category a new file belongs to. Both read one list — lib/catalog.ts CATEGORY_ORDER — and that list named 11 of the 21 categories the shelf actually holds.
how_measured: Merged the two catalogs exactly as app/shelf/page.tsx does (drive-catalog.json, then catalog.json wins on id) and ranked every item with categoryRank(), before and after. Then read the rendered page: 'next dev' on the app with APP_BASE_PATH=/gannenet, Playwright reading the chip row on /shelf and the <select> on /shelf/upload.

before.consequence_browse: All 10 unranked categories tie at rank 11, so the chip tail was ordered by the date of each category's oldest file: מיומנויות — מוכנות חשבון, מיומנויות — גרפומוטוריקה, כללי, ספירת העומר / ל"ג בעומר, שבת ופרשת שבוע, מיומנויות — תפיסה חזותית, מידות ורגש, משחקים והפעלות, סיפורים ושירים, מיומנויות — קריאה ושפה. ספירת העומר / ל"ג בעומר — a holiday, between פסח and שבועות — sat 14th, after דפי צביעה.
before.consequence_upload: The upload form's category dropdown is CATEGORY_ORDER.map(), so a teacher adding material could file it into 11 categories and not into the other 10 — including כללי, which holds 679 files.

after.rationale: Holidays in the order the school year meets them, then the year-round groups: the weekly parasha, the four skills tracks, מידות ורגש, the material types, and כללי last as the catch-all.

rendered.shelf_chips_note: 21 categories + the 'הכול' chip; the rendered order equals the computed order exactly

also_changed: sortItems() and orderedCategories() now tie-break equal ranks by category name (he). Nothing in the current data is unranked any more, but a category arriving later from the Drive catalog would otherwise have had its items scattered through the tail by date instead of staying together.
evidence: _before.json — the merged shelf read through the 11-entry list
_after.json — the same read through the 21-entry list
not_done: Nothing is deployed: gannenet still has no Vercel project and the quota is refused (core.issues #83). public_visible stays false. No database write, nothing protected touched, test mode.
